Render a focusable, visually-hidden `<textarea id="ime-bridge" aria-label="IME bridge">` (NOT display:none / visibility:hidden — keep it in the layout) and an `<output id="ime-out" data-composed data-committed></output>`, both driven by RwSignals.

VERIFIED on 0.8.23 (compiled and passed a CDP run today — copy it): `use web_sys::CompositionEvent; let composed = RwSignal::new(String::new()); let committed = RwSignal::new(String::new());` `view! { <textarea id="ime-bridge" aria-label="IME bridge" style="position:fixed;left:0;top:0;width:1px;height:1px;opacity:0.01" on:compositionstart=move |e| composed.set(e.data().unwrap_or_default()) on:compositionupdate=move |e| composed.set(e.data().unwrap_or_default()) on:compositionend=move |e| { let d = e.data().unwrap_or_default(); composed.set(String::new()); committed.set(d) } on:input=move |e| committed.set(event_target_value(&e))></textarea> <output id="ime-out" data-composed=move || composed.get() data-committed=move || committed.get()></output> }`. `e.data()` returns Option<String>. Read the attributes immediately after each step with `await page.getAttribute('#ime-out', 'data-composed')`.
